item.title: 'Still Not Enough': Nevadans struggle as SNAP rules tighten
item.description: Starting March 1st, able-bodied adults without dependents will be required to complete 20 hours of approved work activities each week to continue receiving benefits.

item.title: Barry Manilow postpones Las Vegas residency dates following surgery for lung cancer
item.description: Longtime Las Vegas headliner and music legend Barry Manilow announced Wednesday that he will be postponing his February residency dates at the Westgate Las Vegas following surgery for lung cancer.

item.title: Las Vegas bio lab sparks information sharing, federal oversight concerns: 'I'm disappointed'
item.description: It remained unclear Wednesday why a suspected illegal bio lab in Las Vegas was not raided until last weekend, even though its owner was known to have ties to Southern Nevada as early as several years ago.

item.title: 2 teens won’t face charges in Las Vegas in alleged sex assault on 8th grade field trip
item.description: Two of four teens who Las Vegas Metro police said are seen on video sexually assaulting another student on a field trip to Costa Rica will not face charges in Nevada, the 8 News Now Investigators have learned.
